resolved_findings.resolution: Manager hardWakeup retains pending SYN, active outgoing/unsent-inbound handshake, finite application wait and eligible idle deadlines while blocked output suppresses only packet retry/output readiness. Actor tick/queued notification runs before blocked return, so consumed hard deadlines do not create an expired-timer loop. Active-only inbound timeout preserves Cancelled. Added finite pure and owned-Qt controls.

Actual prior lease is checked before renewal preparation and after signing/encoding, before replacement. Expiry terminates old streams/listener and clears deferred lease authority; valid new LS2 cannot revive old operations. Successful submission rearms against its actual earlier expiry. Existing first-lease behavior and unexpired same-identity renewal remain intact. Added actual owned shorter-lease/expiry/later-renewal method.

Actor anchors one absolute steady-millisecond end before entropy/Destination preparation, passes it into pure connect, and existing post-signing tick enforces it before dispatch. Pure connect refuses exhausted/extended ends without allocating a slot. Inbound accept retains original pending SYN end. Added exact boundary controls.

scope_limits: This is source review, with no compiler, JVM, runtime, router, or private-loader credit.
The owned queued-frame test does not establish sustained physical TCP-backpressure coverage; pure hardWakeup tests cover the policy boundary.
Native generated peers are not original-Java manager acceptance. Existing finite four-stream/four-SYN, shared lifetime1024 ID and single socket-frame bounds remain explicit.
Public/Host/default backend activation, addressbook/proxy integration and full Streaming parity are outside this capsule.
